nodes.label: Layered by Project, Not by Behavior
nodes.norm_label: layered by project, not by behavior
nodes.rationale: Domain -> Persistence -> Application -> Api split is structural only; Application holds no code and controllers inject AppDbContext directly with no services/repositories/DTOs.

nodes.label: Separate OpenAPI Documentation Host
nodes.rationale: Keeps NSwag and Newtonsoft.Json out of the production API; Newtonsoft configured camelCase to match System.Text.Json output.

nodes.label: SQLite File Database with Auto-Migrations
nodes.rationale: No database server required; EF Core code-first migrations applied automatically on startup.

nodes.label: URL-based Versioning via EventsHubBaseController
nodes.rationale: All controllers inherit EventsHubBaseController which applies [ApiController] and route api/v1/[controller].

nodes.label: Application as Transitive Reference Bridge
nodes.rationale: Api references only Application; deleting the empty project breaks access to AppDbContext and Event.

nodes.label: Events - Create- 200 (Bruno request)
nodes.rationale: POST {{baseUrl}}/Events with randomized payload; test script asserts 404 'The event was not found', copied from Get-404 and inconsistent with the 200 name

nodes.label: Events - Delete- 200 (Bruno request)
nodes.rationale: DELETE {{baseUrl}}/Events/:eventid with hard-coded id 01ef5ae3-...; test script asserts 404, inconsistent with name

nodes.label: Events - Edit - 204 (Bruno request)
nodes.rationale: PUT {{baseUrl}}/Events with hard-coded id 01ef5ae3-...; test script asserts 404, inconsistent with 204 name

nodes.label: Hard-coded seeded event IDs
nodes.rationale: Seed uses random GUIDs, so requests with fixed ids only pass against the DB they were written for; copy an id from List response

nodes.label: Derive expected values from DB, not hard-coded ids
nodes.norm_label: derive expected values from db, not hard-coded ids
nodes.rationale: Seeded ids are random

nodes.label: Shared SQLite test database (GlobalTestSetup)
nodes.rationale: One AppDbContext/file for the whole run, migrated and seeded like the API; writes leak between tests and persist across runs, delete the .db to reset

nodes.label: axios declared in web/package.json
nodes.rationale: npm install must run in both web/ and web/EventsHub/

nodes.label: CORS restricted to localhost:3000
nodes.rationale: Vite dev server must run on port 3000 because API CORS only allows http(s)://localhost:3000

nodes.label: Clean Architecture (Robert C. Martin)
nodes.rationale: Business rules at the center; frameworks, DB and UI are replaceable details. Costs more projects, interfaces and mapping code.

nodes.label: Repository and Unit of Work
nodes.rationale: DbContext already implements both; pragmatic path is repositories for write-side aggregates and direct DbContext queries for reads.

nodes.label: The Dependency Rule
nodes.rationale: Source dependencies point only inward; inner layers own interfaces (dependency inversion) so outer layers implement them.
